summary: Flushes pending Unicode buffer bytes (a 2-byte unit at this+0x16AB/0x16AC with a pending-count dword at this+0x16AD) into an output byte buffer (base this+8, write position this+0x14), then clears the pending state. When the pending count exceeds 8 the full 2-byte unit is written; otherwise a single pending byte is written when any is present.

local_names.pending_unit: word at this+0x16AB (low byte 0x16AB, high byte 0x16AC)
local_names.out_buffer: byte buffer base pointer at this+8

operations.description: Read pending-count dword at this+0x16AD; branch on whether it is <= 8 (single/flush path) or > 8 (two-byte path).
Single-byte path (count > 0 and <= 8): copy pending low byte at this+0x16AB into out_buffer[out_pos] and post-increment out_pos.
Two-byte path (count > 8): copy pending low byte at this+0x16AB into out_buffer[out_pos], then copy pending high byte at this+0x16AC into out_buffer[out_pos+1], advancing out_pos by 2 in total.
Clear the pending 2-byte unit at this+0x16AB to 0.
Clear the pending-count dword at this+0x16AD to 0.

unresolved: Meaning of the count threshold (8) at this+0x16AD is not grounded in the packet; both branches clear the pending state identically.
Caller context: invoked by HuffmanBitStreamEncoder and ChecksummedBufferWriter; the exact condition selecting the one-byte vs two-byte flush path is not derivable from this packet alone.
